thread:
elaine_support: FYI — FinApp says after our v7.1 rollout yesterday responses feel a bit less "warm" and drop the offer-to-help line. They sent side-by-side samples and want us to investigate.

elaine_support: Customer prompt they sent: \"How do I reset my API key?\" — customer expects a polite step-by-step and a closing offer to help.

elaine_support: Customer's "before" (v7.0) response from their logs: \"To reset your API key go to Settings → API Keys, click 'Rotate', confirm. Once rotated update apps. Let me know if you want me to walk through the steps.\"

elaine_support: Customer's "after" (v7.1) response: \"Go to Settings → API Keys and rotate it. Update your apps.\"

matt_engineer: Small change but clearly measurable for their UX — trimming the closing sentence. Do we have request_ids + headers? Was any downstream post-processing applied? :thinking: 

elaine_support: They provided request ids: req_7a1b (v7.0 sample) and req_b9c3 (v7.1 sample). Both returned 200; same user prompt and settings (temp=0.2, max_tokens=120). No middleware on their side according to their notes.

elaine_support: Minimal repro curl (v7.1):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v7.1","prompt":"How do I reset my API key?","temperature":0.2,"max_tokens":120}'
```

matt_engineer: Thanks — quick sanity check in logs: prompt text looks identical for both req ids. No trimming server-side.

ryan_prod: I ran a quick A/B locally switching model weights. v7.0 typically appends an extra closing/help line ~35% of runs; v7.1 drops it closer to ~8%. Looks like a subtle distribution shift in ending tokens (periods vs offer-of-help phrase). Could be beam/stop-token/prob normalization change after re-tuning.

matt_engineer: Filing INF-4829 to track. Tagging eng-ml. @ryan_prod can you attach token-level log-probs + decoding parameters and a short reproducer?

ryan_prod: On it, pushing diffs and the seed logs now :eyes:. Will include a small reproducer toggling sampling and top_p.

ops-bot: Incident INF-4829 created. Priority: P2. Owners: eng-ml, infra.

elaine_support: I'll acknowledge the customer and offer a short-term rollback to v7.0 if they prefer. Also asking for any additional transcripts. :+1:

matt_engineer: Sounds good. If they request rollback, infra can pin and we can monitor. Otherwise eng-ml will investigate tokenization/decoding shifts and report back by EOD.
